title: Table of Contents Page Locations
description: Human-reviewed PDF page locations of the Table of Contents for each issue of a magazine. Sourced from the trains_magazine_extractor review pipeline.

issues.description: Map from issue date (YYYY-MM) to TOC location data.

pdf_page_numbers.description: 1-based pdf_page_numbers containing the Table of Contents. Usually one element; occasionally two for a spread TOC. Empty array when the reviewer confirmed no TOC exists in this issue.
